name: career-intelligence

workspace_binding._comment: XOS-39: hooks that scaffold/commit cwd-relative files run ONLY when cwd is a bound Career OS workspace. Enforced by hooks/scripts/_workspace-gate.sh (sourced by every mutating hook). Plugins that write fixed paths use mode:global.

description: Career Intelligence Engine (xHumanOS) v0.72.0 — job search, network, pipeline, resume, interview-prep, and outreach skills for Claude Code, backed by the brain-kernel. Recent: warm-contact-outreach-dedup gate made JSON-aware (it globbed .md only while live people files are 100% .json, so the double-outreach guard silently never fired — now reads .json people files for name/date/summary), claim-grounding + off-rubric risk gates, flat-path canonicalization onto career-intelligence/projects/job-search/, and a workspace-identity gate across all session hooks so the engine never scaffolds or commits outside its own workspace. Detection: $CAREER_HOME match OR brain/identity/ marker OR .career-os-workspace sentinel.
